subject: Fireburg Hotel
text: Staying at the hotel in Fireburg costs 95 GP.

evidence.quote: Anyway, you can stay for 95 GP.

subject: Reuben
text: Reuben joins Benjamin after Benjamin agrees to help him rescue his dad.

evidence.quote: Benjamin agrees to help, so Reuben joins.

subject: Reuben's house
text: A chest inside Reuben's house contains Refreshers.

evidence.quote: Don't forget to get the Refreshers from the chest before heading on out.

subject: Tristam
text: Tristam is by the bar in the hotel and hands over the Multi-Key which opens locks.

evidence.quote: He's over by the bar. Tristam hands you the Multi-Key which opens locks.

subject: Mega Grenade
text: The man inside the locked house teaches Benjamin how to throw and use a Mega Grenade.

evidence.quote: He'll also teach you how to use a Mega Grenade. Just throw it.

subject: Battle Axe
text: A woman in the lower-left house of Fireburg sells a Battle Axe for 500 GP.

evidence.quote: A woman will sell you a Battle Axe for 500 GP.

subject: Fireburg basement tile
text: Stepping on the strange tile in the woman's basement in Fireburg warps Benjamin to a house in Aquaria.

evidence.quote: If you check out her basement, you'll find a strange tile. Stepping on it will warp to a house in Aquaria.

subject: Battlefield Fifteen
text: Battlefield Fifteen features Sting Rat, Flazzard, and Plant Man enemies and awards a prize of 1200 GP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Fifteen ~
     =-----------------=
          Monsters: Sting Rat, Flazzard, Plant Man
          Prize: 1200 GP

subject: Plant Man
text: Plant Men are weak against the Battle Axe and Reuben's Morning Star.

evidence.quote: Plant Men are weak against the Battle Axe (And Reuben's Morning Star).

subject: Flazzard
text: Flazzards and Sting Rats are weak to Blizzard magic.

evidence.quote: Sting Rats can be obliterated with Blizzard. Flazzards are probably a new monster to you. They're weak to Blizzard as well.

subject: Battlefield Sixteen
text: Battlefield Sixteen features Flazzard and Red Cap monsters and awards the Thunder Spell.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Sixteen ~
     =-----------------=
          Monsters: Flazzard, Red Cap
          Prize: Thunder Spell

subject: Red Cap
text: Red Caps can use Stare to confuse party units or Hypno-sleep to put someone to sleep.

evidence.quote: Red Caps are easy to beat too, but they can use Stare to confuse your units or Hypno-sleep to put someone to sleep.

subject: Mine northern platform
text: Chests blocked by monsters on the upper northern platform contain Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Monsters block these chests, but they provide good EXP. Fight them all and pick up the Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

subject: Mine lower eastern room
text: A chest guarded by a Red Bone contains the Charm Claw, which can inflict status ailments upon enemies.

evidence.quote: A Red Bone guards a single chest. Inside is a Charm Claw; a very useful weapon that can inflict multiple status ailments upon an enemy.

subject: Mine bombed cave
text: A chest reached by bombing a cracked wall and climbing the far wall contains Explosives.

evidence.quote: Kill off the Red Bone and climb the other wall to the chest. It contains some Explosives.

subject: Jinn
text: Jinn's Flame Pillar inflicts 200+ damage to both party units, and Mega Grenade or Thunder deals heavy damage to him.

evidence.quote: Jinn's Flame Pillar move is the one you will want to watch out for. 200+ damage will be dealt to both of your units....Use Mega Grenade or the Wizard spell, Thunder, to deal heavy damage.

subject: Jinn
text: Jinn can be poisoned using the Charm Claw.

evidence.quote: With the Charm Claw, you can poison Jinn.

subject: Mine chasm area
text: Four chests are located outside the door previously blocked by Jinn.

evidence.quote: Outside, take the contents of the four chests and look across the chasm.

subject: Sealed Temple chests
text: The chests in the Sealed Temple contain Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: Take the Heal Potions and Cure Potions from the chests and check out that weird tile.

subject: Sealed Temple tile
text: Stepping onto the strange tile in the Sealed Temple warps the party to the Wintry Temple.

evidence.quote: Take the Heal Potions and Cure Potions from the chests and check out that weird tile. You will be warped to the Wintry Temple.

subject: Wintry Temple warp room
text: Two chests holding potions are located at the Wintry Temple warp destination.

evidence.quote: You will be warped to the Wintry Temple. There are two chests here as well. Pick up some more potions for the road.

subject: Battlefield Seventeen
text: Battlefield Seventeen contains Red Bone, Zombie, and Ghost enemies and rewards 1200 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Seventeen ~
     =-------------------=
          Monsters: Red Bone, Zombie, Ghost
          Prize: 1200 EXP

subject: Zombie
text: Zombies can regenerate themselves if not defeated quickly, and casting Cure deals heavy damage against them.

evidence.quote: The only real danger with Zombies is the fact that they can regenerate themselves if you take too long. The Cure spell can deal heavy damage if you use it against them.

subject: Volcano first cave
text: A chest reached by climbing the northeast entrance staircase and going through the cave contains the White spell.

evidence.quote: Head a tiny bit to the left and exit through the other opening. The chest contains the White spell; a very powerful Wizard spell.

subject: Volcano entrance lower ledge
text: A chest guarded by monsters to the left of the second entrance staircase contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: To the left of it are some monsters guarding a single chest. Inside are some Cure Potions.

subject: Volcano gas tunnel exit
text: Exiting through the wall opening in the gas-filled area leads to a chest with Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Head right to get out. Steal some Heal Potions and keep going.

subject: Volcano fork straight path
text: Explosives are found straight ahead at the path split in the Volcano.

evidence.quote: Once at the next area, you have two ways to go. Some Explosives are straight ahead.

subject: Volcano upper gas-free area
text: Defeating the Were Wolf at the top of the steps yields the Mask from a treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Kill off the Were Wolf and snag the Mask from the chest.

subject: Volcano Mask room ledge
text: A chest behind a Nitemare to the left of the Mask contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: defeat the Nitemare to your left. The chest behind it contains some more Cure Potions.

subject: Volcano east staircase path
text: Taking the path to the right before climbing the eastern steps leads to Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: You can choose to take the path on the right for some Cure Potions before climbing the steps.

subject: Volcano summit ledge
text: Enemies on the upper ledge before the final staircase guard Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Before continuing up the stairs to your left, you can beat up some more enemies for some Heal Potions.

subject: Medusa
text: The White spell deals massive damage to Medusa, defeating her in only a few castings.

evidence.quote: White deals a lot of damage. Only a few castings are needed to put her down.

subject: Medusa
text: Medusa uses Screech Voice to confuse, Stone Voice to petrify, and Para-snake to paralyze party members.

evidence.quote: Beware of her Screech Voice move; it's capable of confusing a unit. Stone Voice can petrify and Para-snake can paralyze.

subject: Lava Dome cracked rock cave
text: A chest guarded by a Medusa-type monster behind a cracked rock in the Lava Dome contains the Life spell.

evidence.quote: Demolish the cracked rock a Mega Grenade and beat up the Medusa-wannabe. The chest she was guarding contains the Life spell!

subject: Lava Dome northwest upper path
text: A chest at the end of the northwest path above the climbing wall holds exactly 20 Explosives.

evidence.quote: At the end of the northwest path are some Explosives -- 20 to be exact.

subject: Lava Dome southwest exit
text: A chest outside the southwest cave exit contains three Refreshers.

evidence.quote: Clear the monsters out of the way and leave through this alternative exit. Three Refreshers can be found in the chest.

subject: Lava Dome monster room
object: Refreshers, Heal Potions, and Cure Potions
text: Chests scattered across the monster-infested cave room contain Refreshers, Heal Potions, and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: The next area is absolutely infested with monsters. Fight them for the valuable EXP and pick up some Refreshers, Heal Potions, and Cure Potions.

subject: Lava Dome northwest chest room
text: The chest to the far northwest past the blasted boulders contains the Moon Helm.

evidence.quote: Keep going north until you reach two chests. The one to the far northwest contains a Moon Helm.

subject: Lava Dome northwest chest room
text: The second chest in the northwest room past the blasted boulders contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: The one to the far northwest contains a Moon Helm. The other holds some Cure Potions.

subject: Lava Dome ledge cave
text: Entering the ledge cave near the switch reveals a first chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: See the cave on your ledge? Enter it for some items. The first chest has some Cure Potions.

subject: Lava Dome deeper fork north path
text: Following the north fork in the deeper chamber yields Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote: At the split, head north. Upon reaching the end of this path, you'll be rewarded with some Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

subject: Lava Dome Stheno ledge
text: Defeating the Stheno after jumping the second gap allows access to a chest with Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Jump the next gap and kill off the Stheno to access the chest. Take the Heal Potions and return to the stairs.

subject: Lava Dome Adamant Turtle platform
text: Jumping across the second eastern gap and defeating an Adamant Turtle allows collecting Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Ignore the first gap jump across the second. After getting rid a Adamant Turtle, you can pick up some Heal Potions.
